remarks: Exceptional investment and lifestyle opportunity in the highly desirable Bulls Head neighborhood of Stamford! Tucked away on a quiet dead-end street just minutes from vibrant downtown, this rare three-unit, legal two-family property offers versatility, strong income potential and modern updates throughout. The front residence (Unit 1) is a charming Cape Cod-style home featuring 3 bedrooms and 1.5 baths. The main level offers a classic layout with a spacious living room, dining room, eat-in kitchen and a primary bedroom with convenient in-unit laundry. Upstairs, you'll find two additional bedrooms and a half bath. The rear residence (Unit 2), built in 2005 and located above the three-car garage, offers a bright and open floor plan with 1 bedroom and 1.5 baths. This thoughtfully designed space includes a kitchen with granite countertops and center island, dining and living areas, central vacuum and a laundry room. The primary suite features cathedral ceilings, skylights, a walk-in closet, and an oversized bath with jacuzzi tub. Sliding doors lead to a private deck overlooking a level backyard. (Unit 3) has been newly constructed in 2024 and serves as a fully independent in-law/studio apartment. With its own private entrance, kitchen, full bath and open layout, it provides excellent rental or multigenerational living potential. Thank you for all of the great interest and feedback on this incredible and unique property! We have multiple offer - Please submit by Tues, 4/07 @ 5pm.
